items.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023
items.q: And Larry Williams who also was in Seawind... I went to Indiana with Larry Williams and Gary Grant

ctx.x: Did you ever write something that you couldn’t play? © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

If I couldn’t play it I wouldn’t write it. But yeah, back in the day it was anything goes back then. You know Chuck Findley can play anything. You know Gary’s amazing. And Bill Reichenbach on the trombone is also just a world class player. An amazing bass trombone player, trombone player, plays drums, great writer. And Larry Williams who also was in Seawind, and Dan Higgins who has been recently, who is just a brilliant musician. So you know you go in with those kind of guys like that, and now Wayne Bergeron…

Do you get ideas in your head even when you’re not really engaged in working? I guess I think I saw your dog come through the room. And when I take my dog for a walk if I’m working on an arrangement I get these things — you know I’m thinking more about how am I going to solve this little issue. I wonder if this happens to you?
